**Finding: deviation (AUDIT) — § 3.4, paragraph p0022**

The only inspection right binding us is § 3.4 (HDI's General Manager may inspect our payment-calculation records). HDI's § 1.4 access obligations run in our favour and were not flagged; no other audit, verification or system-access language exists in the document.

Against the fallback checklist:
- **Notice** — already met: "no less than thirty (30) days prior written notice to the Company" (well above the 15-day floor).
- **Cost** — already met: "The fees incurred by HDI in connection with the inspection shall be borne by HDI" (unconditional, better than the underpayment-threshold formulation).
- **Frequency** — failed: the clause is unlimited. Cured by a single surgical insertion: "have the right, **no more than once per year,** to inspect the records".

The clause now sits at the fallback. Preferred-only extras (independent auditor, confidentiality undertaking, off-site where possible, express no-system-access) are noted but not pressed, since inspection is already confined to payment records at our premises during business hours.
